blocking.label: Blocking
blocking.description: +N applies to Oppose rolls. Guard with the Quick Action (PHB 6.5.1).

craft.label: Craft
craft.description: A Trade roll for general work in no single Material.

edged.label: Edged
edged.description: +3 Stress against a physical Attribute. Physical Resistance, after Pierce, counts double against it.

fortifying.label: Fortifying
fortifying.description: Support, aimed at an ally or the caster.

immobile.label: Immobile
immobile.description: +2 Stress. Fixed at a location; using it means being there.

incorporeal.label: Incorporeal
incorporeal.description: +1 Stress against a mental Attribute. -1 against a physical Attribute.

kinetic.label: Kinetic
kinetic.description: +1 Stress against a physical Attribute. -1 against a mental Attribute.

parry.label: Parry
parry.description: Spend the Quick Action reactively for Physical Resistance +1 against a Melee or Ranged Technique (PHB 6.5.2).

pointed.label: Pointed
pointed.description: Pierce 1 against Physical Resistance. +1 Stress against a physical Attribute.

quick.label: Quick
quick.description: Creatures only (GMG 9.6.0): this natural weapon's built-in Techniques may be used as a Quick Action. A Light Instrument already can (PHB 4.1.1).

sonic.label: Sonic
sonic.description: +1 Stress against a mental Attribute. -1 against a physical Attribute.

counter.label: Counter
counter.description: Contest another Technique as it lands, minus its Strain. A countered upkeep ends the Technique.

disarm.label: Disarm
disarm.description: The target drops the Instrument it used last. Innate Instruments can't be dropped.

extend-range.label: Extend Range
extend-range.description: 1 XP per band of extra reach.

hasten-quick.label: Hasten (Quick Action)
hasten-quick.description: Grant an ally an extra Quick Action.

lingering.label: Lingering N
lingering.description: N more Stress at the start of the target's next turns.

mend.label: Mend Xd4
mend.description: Remove Xd4 Stress from one of an ally's Attributes, with no Medicine and no roll. Medicine or Mend once every 2 hours per creature (PHB 6.10.0).

reeling-minute.label: -N [Oppose] (1 minute)
reeling-minute.description: Reeling: the target's Oppose rolls take -N for 1 minute (PHB 6.8.6).

reeling.label: -N [Oppose]
reeling.description: Reeling: the target's Oppose rolls take -N for 1 round (PHB 6.8.6).

skill-mod-minute.label: +N [Skill or Oppose] (1 minute)
skill-mod-minute.description: +N to a named Skill's rolls for 1 minute.

skill-mod.label: +N [Skill or Oppose]
skill-mod.description: +N to a named Skill's rolls for 1 round.

weaken.label: -N [target Attribute]
weaken.description: Weakened: the named Attribute's rolls take -N for 1 round (PHB 6.8.4).

weaken-minute.label: -N [target Attribute] (1 minute)
weaken-minute.description: Weakened: the named Attribute's rolls take -N for 1 minute (PHB 6.8.4).

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.description: Beam or Wall: 1 + 2 + ... per band. Cone 3x, Radius 12x the Beam cost. A Melee Pattern reaches no farther than its Instrument's Range.

quick.label: Quick
quick.description: 3 XP, outside the combination premium. A stated trigger sets the 8 XP floor.

selective.label: Selective
selective.description: Creatures within R bands: range at 1 XP per band, plus an 8 XP premium; Strain is paid per target.

stress.label: Stress
stress.description: Deal the margin to an Attribute of the Target.

upkeep.label: Upkeep
upkeep.description: Keep an Action Technique active by paying a Quick Action and its Strain at the start of each later turn.
